This is only relevant when cost_type is MEDIA_SHARE. When cost_type is not MEDIA_SHARE, and this field is set, a MAX_COST_NOT_ALLOWED error will be returned. If not set or set to`0`, there is no cap.

costMicros.description: Optional. The cost associated with the model, in micro units (10^-6), in the currency specified by the currency_code field. For example, 2000000 means $2 if `currency_code` is `USD`.
